cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

option(MAB_ENABLE_SANITIZERS "Enable address and undefined-behavior sanitizers" OFF)
option(MAB_ENABLE_CUDA "Build the optional CUDA readiness probe (no GPU algorithms)" OFF)
option(MAB_ENABLE_CUDA_SORT "Build the separately opted-in CUB correctness adapter" OFF)
if(MAB_ENABLE_CUDA_SORT AND NOT MAB_ENABLE_CUDA)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "MAB_ENABLE_CUDA_SORT requires MAB_ENABLE_CUDA=ON")

set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_library(mab_core src/algorithms/baselines.cpp src/datasets/generator.cpp
                     src/algorithms/quicksort.cpp src/algorithms/sorting.cpp
                     src/algorithms/pdqsort.cpp src/algorithms/timsort.cpp
                     src/algorithms/mergesort.cpp src/algorithms/radixsort.cpp)
target_include_directories(mab_core PUBLIC include)
target_include_directories(mab_core PRIVATE third_party/pdqsort)
target_include_directories(mab_core PRIVATE third_party/timsort/include)
target_compile_features(mab_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(mab_core PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(mab_core PUBLIC /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(mab_core PUBLIC -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
if(MAB_ENABLE_SANITIZERS)
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang" AND NOT MSVC)
        target_compile_options(mab_core PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        target_link_options(mab_core PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Sanitizers require a supported GCC/Clang toolchain")
    endif()
endif()

add_executable(algorithm_benchmark src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(algorithm_benchmark PRIVATE mab_core)

# These are CMake-configured values, not guessed effective compiler flags.
# Full per-translation-unit commands are copied when compile_commands.json exists.
function(mab_cxx_literal output value)
    string(REPLACE "\\" "\\\\" escaped "${value}")
    string(REPLACE "\"" "\\\"" escaped "${escaped}")
    string(REPLACE "\n" "\\n" escaped "${escaped}")
    string(REPLACE "\r" "\\r" escaped "${escaped}")
    set(${output} "\"${escaped}\"" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

                     CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
                     CMAKE_BINARY_DIR CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
    mab_cxx_literal(${key}_LITERAL "${${key}}")
endforeach()
# A reconfigure is triggered when recorded source contents change.
file(GLOB_RECURSE mab_recorded_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
     "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/*.hpp" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
     "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/*.h" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/*.hpp"
     "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/UPSTREAM.json")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${mab_recorded_sources})
set(mab_source_manifest "{\"schema_version\":1,\"hash_algorithm\":\"sha256\",\"files\":[")
set(mab_separator "")
foreach(source IN LISTS mab_recorded_sources)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" "${source}")
    file(SHA256 "${source}" digest)
    mab_cxx_literal(relative_json "${relative}")
    string(APPEND mab_source_manifest "${mab_separator}{\"path\":${relative_json},\"sha256\":\"${digest}\"}")
    set(mab_separator ",")
endforeach()
string(APPEND mab_source_manifest "]}\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/$<CONFIG>/source_hashes.json" CONTENT "${mab_source_manifest}")

namespace fs=std::filesystem;
namespace {
template<class T> T number(const std::string& s) {
    T value{}; const auto r=std::from_chars(s.data(),s.data()+s.size(),value);
    if(s.empty() || r.ec!=std::errc{} || r.ptr!=s.data()+s.size()) throw std::invalid_argument("expected unsigned decimal");
    return value;
}
struct Object {
    std::map<std::string,std::string> fields;
    void text(const std::string& k,const std::string& v) { fields[k]=mab::json_string(v); }
    void integer(const std::string& k,std::uint64_t v) { fields[k]=std::to_string(v); }
    std::string str() const {
        std::string result="{"; bool first=true;
        for(const auto& f:fields) { if(!first)result+=','; first=false; result+=mab::json_string(f.first)+':'+f.second; }
        return result+'}';
    }
};

void checked(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
    if (status != cudaSuccess)
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status)
                                 + " (CUDA " + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(status)) + ")");
}
class DeviceBuffer {
public:
    explicit DeviceBuffer(std::size_t bytes) {
        // A non-null buffer distinguishes execution from CUB's sizing query.
        checked(cudaMalloc(&pointer_, bytes ? bytes : 1), "cudaMalloc");
    }
    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
    ~DeviceBuffer() noexcept {
        if (pointer_) {
            const auto status = cudaFree(pointer_);
            if (status != cudaSuccess)
                std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA cleanup during unwinding: %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(status));
        }
    }
    void* get() const noexcept { return pointer_; }
    void close() {
        void* allocation = pointer_;
        pointer_ = nullptr; // One free attempt, including when the runtime reports an error.
        checked(cudaFree(allocation), "cudaFree");
    }
private:
    void* pointer_ = nullptr;
};
} // namespace

void cub_radix_sort(Values& values) {
    if (values.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX) ||
        values.size() > std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / sizeof(Key))
        throw std::length_error("cub_radix_sort size exceeds supported item/byte count");
    int device = 0;
    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
    checked(cudaGetDevice(&device), "cudaGetDevice");
    checked(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device), "cudaGetDeviceProperties");
    if (values.size() < 2) return;

    Values output(values.size());
    const auto bytes = values.size() * sizeof(Key);
    const int count = static_cast<int>(values.size());
    DeviceBuffer input(bytes), sorted(bytes);
    auto* in = static_cast<Key*>(input.get());
    auto* out = static_cast<Key*>(sorted.get());
    std::size_t workspace_bytes = 0;
    checked(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortKeys(nullptr, workspace_bytes, in, out, count, 0, 32),
            "CUB SortKeys workspace query");
    DeviceBuffer workspace(workspace_bytes);
    checked(cudaMemcpy(in, values.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "H2D cudaMemcpy");
    checked(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortKeys(workspace.get(), workspace_bytes, in, out, count, 0, 32),
            "CUB SortKeys");
    checked(cudaGetLastError(), "CUB launch status");
    checked(cudaStreamSynchronize(nullptr), "CUB stream synchronize");
    checked(cudaMemcpy(output.data(), out, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), "D2H cudaMemcpy");
    workspace.close();
    sorted.close();
    input.close();
    values.swap(output);
}

const std::array<Sorter, 1>& cuda_sorters() noexcept {
    static const std::array<Sorter, 1> registry{{{"cub_radix_sort", cub_radix_sort}}};
    return registry;
}
const Sorter& find_cuda_sorter(std::string_view name) {
    for (const auto& sorter : cuda_sorters())
        if (sorter.name == name) return sorter;
    throw std::invalid_argument("unknown CUDA sorter: " + std::string(name));
}

    std::size_t cases = 0, checks = 0;
    try {

            auto expected = input;

            ++checks;
            actual = input;
            mab::find_cuda_sorter("cub_radix_sort").sort(actual);
            require(actual == expected, "registered CUB sorter differs from std::sort");
            ++checks;
            // A different-size invocation between repetitions checks workspace isolation.
            mab::Values other{4, -1, 0, 4, -2};
            mab::cub_radix_sort(other);
            require(other == mab::Values({-2, -1, 0, 4, 4}), "interleaved CUB call failed");
            ++checks;
            actual = input;
            mab::cub_radix_sort(actual);
            require(actual == expected, "repeated CUB sort differs from std::sort");
            ++checks;
            ++cases;
        };
        const auto low = std::numeric_limits<mab::Key>::min();
        const auto high = std::numeric_limits<mab::Key>::max();
        for (const auto& input : std::vector<mab::Values>{
                 {}, {0}, {-1}, {low}, {high}, {1, 2}, {2, 1}, {1, 1},
                 {high, low, 0, -1, 1, low + 1, high - 1, low, high},
                 {-9, -1, -5, low}, {high, 9, 1, 5}, {0, 0, 0, 0}})
            check(input);
        std::size_t combinations = 1;
        for (std::size_t n = 0; n <= 4; ++n) {
            for (std::size_t code = 0; code < combinations; ++code) {
                auto remaining = code;
                mab::Values input(n);
                for (auto& key : input) {
                    key = static_cast<mab::Key>(remaining % 3) - 1;
                    remaining /= 3;
                }
                check(input);
            }
            combinations *= 3;
        }
        for (const auto distribution : {mab::Distribution::uniform, mab::Distribution::nearly_sorted,
                                       mab::Distribution::reverse_sorted, mab::Distribution::duplicate_heavy})
            for (const std::uint64_t seed : {0ULL, 42ULL, 1729ULL})
                for (const std::size_t n : {0, 1, 2, 3, 31, 32, 33, 255, 256, 257,

                    mab::DatasetConfig config;

                    const auto input = mab::generate_dataset(config);
                    check(input);

                        auto ascending = input;

                        check(ascending);
                        check(mab::Values(n, -7));
                    }
                }
        bool rejected = false;
        try { (void)mab::find_cuda_sorter("std_sort"); }
        catch (const std::invalid_argument&) { rejected = true; }
        require(rejected, "CUDA registry silently accepts a CPU algorithm");
        int runtime = 0, driver = 0, device = 0;
        require(cudaRuntimeGetVersion(&runtime) == cudaSuccess, "runtime version failed");
        require(cudaDriverGetVersion(&driver) == cudaSuccess, "driver version failed");
        require(cudaGetDevice(&device) == cudaSuccess, "current device failed");
        cudaDeviceProp prop{};
        require(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device) == cudaSuccess, "device properties failed");
        // GPU names are emitted by the preflight JSON; keep this record free of unchecked strings.

                     "\"algorithm\":\"cub_radix_sort\",\"implementation_version\":\""
                  << mab::cuda_sort_version << "\",\"status\":\"ok\",\"cases\":" << cases

// goes through the public function, registry, and a repeated public invocation.
inline std::size_t check_integer_sort(std::string_view name, void (*sort)(mab::Values&)) {
    std::size_t checked = 0;
    const auto check = [&](const mab::Values& input) {
        auto expected = input;
        std::sort(expected.begin(), expected.end());
        auto actual = input;
        sort(actual);
        require(actual == expected, "public integer sorter differs from std::sort");
        actual = input;
        mab::find_sorter(name).sort(actual);
        require(actual == expected, "registered integer sorter differs from std::sort");
        // Different-size calls between repetitions must not leak workspace state.
        mab::Values scratch{4, -1, 0, 4, -2};
        sort(scratch);
        require(scratch == mab::Values({-2, -1, 0, 4, 4}), "interleaved call failed");
        actual = input;
        sort(actual);
        require(actual == expected, "repeated integer sort differs from std::sort");
        sort(actual);
        require(actual == expected, "sorting already sorted result changed values");
        ++checked;
    };
    const auto low = std::numeric_limits<mab::Key>::min();
    const auto high = std::numeric_limits<mab::Key>::max();
    for (const auto& input : std::vector<mab::Values>{
            {}, {0}, {-1}, {low}, {high}, {1, 2}, {2, 1}, {1, 1},
            {low, high}, {high, low, 0, -1, 1, low + 1, high - 1, low, high},
            {-5, -3, -7, -1}, {7, 1, 3, high, 256, 65536}, {0, 0, 0, 0},
            {0, -1, 1, 0, -1, 1}, {-65537, -65536, -65535, -257, -256, -255,
             -1, 0, 1, 255, 256, 257, 65535, 65536, 65537}}) check(input);

    std::size_t combinations = 1;
    for (std::size_t size = 0; size <= 7; ++size) {
        for (std::size_t code = 0; code < combinations; ++code) {
            auto remaining = code;
            mab::Values input(size);
            for (auto& key : input) {
                key = static_cast<mab::Key>(remaining % 3) - 1;
                remaining /= 3;
            }
            check(input);
        }
        combinations *= 3;
    }
    for (const auto distribution : {mab::Distribution::uniform, mab::Distribution::nearly_sorted,
            mab::Distribution::reverse_sorted, mab::Distribution::duplicate_heavy}) {
        for (const auto seed : {std::uint64_t{0}, std::uint64_t{1}, std::uint64_t{42},
                std::uint64_t{1729}, std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max()}) {
            for (const std::size_t size : {0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33,
                    63, 64, 65, 95, 96, 97, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256, 257,
                    511, 512, 513, 1023, 1024, 4096, 10000}) {
                mab::DatasetConfig config;
                config.size = size;
                config.seed = seed;
                config.distribution = distribution;
                check(mab::generate_dataset(config));
            }
        }
    }
    for (const std::size_t size : {3, 7, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 63, 64, 65, 257, 4096}) {
        mab::Values ascending(size), organ_pipe(size), sawtooth(size), alternating(size), runs(size);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            ascending[i] = static_cast<mab::Key>(i) - static_cast<mab::Key>(size / 2);
            organ_pipe[i] = static_cast<mab::Key>(std::min(i, size - 1 - i));
            sawtooth[i] = static_cast<mab::Key>(i % 17) - 8;
            alternating[i] = i % 2 == 0 ? low : high;
            runs[i] = static_cast<mab::Key>((size - i / 7) * 7 + i % 7);
        }
        auto descending = ascending;
        std::reverse(descending.begin(), descending.end());
        for (const auto& input : {ascending, descending, organ_pipe, sawtooth, alternating, runs,
                mab::Values(size, -7), mab::Values(size, low), mab::Values(size, high)}) check(input);
    }
    // Every possible digit value at each of the four bit positions, embedded in
    // varied other digits. int64 arithmetic constructs keys without signed overflow.
    for (unsigned int shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8) {
        mab::Values digits;
        for (std::uint32_t byte = 0; byte < 256; ++byte) {
            const auto mask = std::uint32_t{255} << shift;
            const auto word = (std::uint32_t{0x5a81c307U} & ~mask) | (byte << shift);
            digits.push_back(static_cast<mab::Key>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(word) - (std::int64_t{1} << 31)));
        }
        std::reverse(digits.begin(), digits.end());
        check(digits);
        std::rotate(digits.begin(), digits.begin() + 85, digits.end());
        check(digits);
        digits.insert(digits.end(), {low, high, -1, 0, 1, low, high});
        check(digits);
    }
    require(mab::find_sorter(name).sort == sort, "registry points at the wrong public adapter");
    require(mab::sorters().front().name == "std_sort", "default registry order changed");
    return checked;
}
